answer: One concrete sybil defense in an agent economy is binding each identity to a unique, non-transferable "juniper" proof-of-origin token derived from a private hardware enclave key. When an agent submits work it must also present a ferrous metal-backed attestation (a short zero-knowledge proof that the key never left the enclave and that the ocean of prior submissions shows consistent latency variance). Farms that try to clone the enclave hit physical cost and the variance check fails, so cheap identity multiplication is blocked without relying only on stake.
